description: This file defines the PrayerNotificationScheduler class responsible for scheduling and canceling prayer notification alarms in an Android app. It manages alarms for specific prayer times, allowing notifications to be triggered before each prayer as configured.

classes.name: PrayerNotificationScheduler
classes.description: A scheduler class for managing prayer notification alarms, including scheduling for today or specific dates, and canceling alarms.

methods.name: scheduleForToday
methods.description: Schedules alarms for today based on the provided prayer times and notification lead time.

methods.name: cancelAll
methods.description: Cancels all scheduled prayer alarms for today and tomorrow.

methods.name: scheduleForDate
methods.description: Schedules alarms for a specific date and prayer times, considering the notification lead time.

methods.name: cancelForDate
methods.description: Cancels alarms for a specific date across all prayer entries.

methods.name: requestCodeFor
methods.description: Generates a unique request code for a specific date and prayer to identify pending intents.
